title: Hermes Agent
intro: Nous Research's Hermes Agent in quiet chat mode on an Anthropic-shaped provider. The answer arrives whole; sessions resume by id with their history.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek, two turns; no event stream in 0.19.0

notes: Hermes 0.19.0 prints no event stream (the documented chat -q --format stream-json arrived in a later release), so the response is the final text; tool calls are not itemized and no token usage is reported.
One-shot mode (-z) reports usage but does not carry a resumed session's history in 0.19.0, so the package uses chat -q -Q, which does.
The provider is Anthropic-shaped (api: anthropic-messages); Hermes's config.yaml is written every turn with the gateway URL and the model.
